'''Paul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At some point around [[3642 BBY]] he was captured by the [[White Maw]] pirates and was put to work in [[Firefrost Lavaworks]], run by a cruel boss [[Gradak Ungan]], who chained slaves to their equipment and as punishment cut off their thermal shield, leading them to die. When a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] visited the Lawaworks on a mission to kill Ungan, Paul begged him to get the key from their shackles so that the prisoners could make a run for it. He offered his thermal shield to make it happen, ready to sacrifice himself for the other prisoners.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paul appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Hoth as "Republic Prisoner." His name is only mentioned by a fellow Imperial prisoner in one of the possible dialogue branches.
